goals: Verify the end-to-end workflow of the wood processing machine, including startup, configuration, loading, and processing.
Verify that the machine successfully processes a wood plank to the user-specified cutting thickness.
activities: Ensure the wood processing machine is turned off
Verify the indicator light is green
Ensure the machine display shows the default thickness
Set the cutting thickness to 2 inches
Verify the blade adjusts to 2 inches
Ensure the machine is on and ready
Ensure the processing mode is selected
Load a wood piece onto the machine feeder
Verify the machine detects the wood
Verify 'Wood detected' is displayed on the screen
Ensure the wood is loaded onto the machine
Ensure the desired thickness is set
Verify the machine processes the wood
Verify the wood comes out at the specified thickness
